issue.title: Bug:cacl/test_cacl_function.py serice acl config does not stay in effect long enough

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`cacl/test_cacl_function.py` is flaky on large topos.

The cause is due to a hardcoded time used for determining when to revert the service acl changes on the DUT - the test state is reverted before the test is done running.

### Steps to Reproduce

On a large topology, run the test and observe the test failing on unexpected SNMP response. (expects a timeout, but gets a good SNMP reply instead.)

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test should be passing.

resolution.title: Extend cacl/test_cacl_function.py test state duration
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Currently, `cacl/test_cacl_function.py` is flaky on large topos.
The cause is due to a hardcoded time used for determining when to revert the service acl changes on the DUT - the test state is reverted before the test is done running.

Fix by extending the duration where the DUT remains in the test state.

Fixes #22271
